description: This Java source file defines the TaxClassController class which manages CRUD operations for tax classes within an administrative web interface. It includes endpoints for listing, paging, creating, updating, editing, and deleting tax class entities, with role-based access control and integration with service and utility classes.

classes.name: TaxClassController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing CRUD and listing operations for TaxClass entities in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list view of tax classes for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: pageTaxClasses
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide a JSON response with paginated tax class data.

methods.name: saveTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new TaxClass entity, after validation checks.

methods.name: updateTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing TaxClass entity, with validation.

methods.name: removeTaxClass
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a TaxClass entity, with checks for product associations.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch a specific TaxClass for editing, identified by its ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set the menu context for requests.
